## What does this print?

:::: {.quiz}

::: {.question}
What does this print?
:::

::: {.answer .incorrect}
`[1, 2]`
:::

::: {.answer .correct}
`[2, 3]`
:::

::: {.solution}
A slice starts at the index you give and runs to the end.
:::

::: {.explanation}
Worth saying out loud: the second number is the end, not a count. This belongs
in the speaker notes, not on the slide.
:::
